purpose: Final strictly bounded 5-day unexposed confirmation/falsification experiment testing G1 (published platform-pair MCT + physical async dwell clock) and rationalized G2 (analytical RecursiveSelectivePlanner and sub-dwell <2.0s bounded certified rollout) before synthesizing the complete 39-day manuscript (Path B).

date_selection.selection_rule: Chronological first 5 unexposed service dates >= 2023-04-06 satisfying complete static GTFS release coverage, unique official daily ist-daten CSV member, and 17/17 morning 10-minute RT capture bins [25200..34800] in Europe/Zurich civil service seconds.

station_max.description: Legacy single parent-station scalar min_transfer_time (e.g. 420s at Zurich HB).

platform_pair.description: 3-tier published/announced platform-pair MCT: (1) explicit GTFS transfers.txt rule (or prohibited=inf), (2) same physical platform tau_same_platform=90s, (3) conservative station fallback.

ideal.description: Legacy zero-latency public clock; solver CPU does not advance physical door/departure deadlines.

async.description: Anytime ActionPublisher against physical ist-daten station dwell [AN_PROGNOSE, max(AB_PROGNOSE_next, AN_PROGNOSE + 1s)]. Fast base action is published first; background rollout overrides are accepted iff completed strictly before physical train departure.

verdict_rules.stopping_rule: If neither recursive_plat_async nor bounded_cert_plat_async achieves a positive date-cluster 95% lower CI over cheap_plat_async, confirm the Path B structural near-optimality stopping rule and conclude solver expansion.
